content: The party enters the Yawning Portal tavern. A half-orc bartender nods at you as the sounds of clinking mugs and raucous laughter fill the air.
Players chose to investigate the mysterious cloaked figure in the corner rather than join the drinking contest.
Eldrin rolls Perception: 18 (1d20+5=13+5). Success! He notices the figure is watching the party intently.
Volo introduces himself and offers the party 10gp each to find his missing friend, Floon Blagmaar.
